reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Authority to make secured personal credit loans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secured personal credit loans subject to local police regulations; lender business classification immaterial.

headings.title: Maximum interest rate and storage charges
headings.reviewNote: Caps interest on secured personal credit loans at two percent per month; permits charges for storage and security of pledged goods.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed authority to make secured personal credit loans, 2% monthly interest cap, and permissive storage/security charges.

headings.title: Receipt requirements for secured personal credit loans
headings.reviewNote: Mandatory receipt for pawn transactions containing nine statutory disclosures including customer ID, loan amount, service charge, and forfeiture terms.

headings.title: Local ordinance reporting and electronic database transmission
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes electronic transmission to third-party database to satisfy local law enforcement reporting; paper copies for on-site inspection.

headings.title: Definitions for electronic pawn reporting
headings.reviewNote: Defines database, permitted user, reportable data, reporting pawnbroker, and search for pawnbroker reporting system.

headings.title: Database purpose and investigative use
headings.reviewNote: Database provides property crime investigative information while protecting pawnbroker and customer privacy rights.

headings.title: Database contents and access security
headings.reviewNote: Database contains recorded pawn and purchase data with security features restricting access to permitted users.

headings.title: Database user fees and pawnbroker cost immunity
headings.reviewNote: Law enforcement agencies charged based on permitted users; pawnbrokers and customers exempt from database costs.

headings.title: Search criteria, audit logging, and criminal penalties
headings.reviewNote: Secure internet access, criminal case identifier requirement, audit log of searches; class D felony for fraudulent access.

headings.title: Electronic transmission deadlines and paper record availability
headings.reviewNote: Daily internet transmission to database by end of next business day and on-site paper records availability.

headings.title: Data error correction and computer malfunction safe harbor
headings.reviewNote: Thirty-day error correction period; 30 to 60 day safe harbor for good-faith repair of computer malfunctions with alternative reporting.

headings.title: Limitation on pawnbroker reporting expenses
headings.reviewNote: Pawnbrokers not obligated to incur costs other than standard internet service for database reporting.

headings.title: Procedure for lost, destroyed, or stolen pawn tickets
headings.reviewNote: Written notice invalidates ticket; requires notarized loss affidavit before reissuance or redemption of pledged goods.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 11 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed pawn receipt disclosures, third-party electronic database reporting, class D felony fraudulent access, malfunction safe harbor, and notarized lost-ticket affidavit.

headings.title: Maturity schedule, default, and 60-day redemption period
headings.reviewNote: Lump sum maturity after 30 days; 60-day retention upon default; title passes to lender on 61st day without foreclosure.

headings.title: Absence of borrower obligation to redeem
headings.reviewNote: Pledgor under no legal obligation to redeem pledged goods or make payments on pawn transaction.

headings.title: Presumption of entitlement to redeem
headings.reviewNote: Person presenting pawn ticket and proper identification presumed entitled to redeem pledged goods.

headings.title: Prohibited pawnbroker acts and secondhand purchase records
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits under-18 pledges, personal liability agreements, waivers, negligence; requires replacement of lost goods and secondhand purchase records.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 30-day maturity, 60-day redemption and automatic title passage, non-obligation to redeem, and prohibited pawnbroker acts/secondhand records.

headings.title: Municipal pawnshop license requirement and qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Municipal license required; applicant qualifications include good moral character, $50,000 net assets, and criminal conviction review.

headings.title: CPA verification of net assets requirement
headings.reviewNote: Independent CPA review and balance sheet finding permitted to verify $50,000 net assets requirement.

headings.title: Application contents, investigation fee, and annual fee
headings.reviewNote: Sworn application, disclosure of principals, $500 initial / $250 additional investigation fee, and $500 annual fee.

headings.title: Optional surety bond requirement and terms
headings.reviewNote: Discretionary surety bond up to $5,000 running to state for compliance with pawn laws and regulations.

headings.title: Recordkeeping and two-year preservation period
headings.reviewNote: Licensee must maintain adequate books and records of pawn transactions for at least two years.

headings.title: Grandfathering of existing pawnshop operators
headings.reviewNote: Pawnbrokers operating on August 28, 1990 exempt from new licensing; $500 annual fee in lieu of occupational license.

headings.title: Excursion gambling boat proximity prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Bans initial pawnshop licensing within one-half mile of gambling boat dock or application site on or after May 20, 1994.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections and Effective 5-20-94 note against archived text; refined subsection (4) title to preserve conditional surety bond requirement and noted municipal/county licensing, 1990 grandfathering, and 1994 gaming proximity bar.

headings.title: Definitions for misappropriated property recovery
headings.reviewNote: Defines claimant, conveying customer, hold order, law enforcement officer, misappropriated, pledgor, purchaser, and seller.

headings.title: Limitation of pawnbroker recourse to pledged goods
headings.reviewNote: Pawnbroker recourse limited strictly to pledged goods unless property was misappropriated.

headings.title: Mandatory proof of identification for sellers and pledgors
headings.reviewNote: Requires government photo identification and address verification for all persons selling or pledging property.

headings.title: Thirty-day holding period absent proof of identification
headings.reviewNote: Mandatory 30-day holding period and signed ownership statement when seller lacks proof of identification.

headings.title: Claimant demand requirements for misappropriated property
headings.reviewNote: Written demand, police theft report with description, and signed sworn affidavit agreeing to assist criminal prosecution.

headings.title: Seven-day return window and small claims petition
headings.reviewNote: Return of property in presence of officer within seven days absent hold order; court petition with fees to prevailing party.

headings.title: Pawnbroker cause of action for false claimant affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Pawnbroker action against claimant for property value and attorney fees upon false affidavit or refusal to cooperate.

headings.title: Pawnbroker third-party action against conveying customer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes pawnbroker to join conveying customer as third party to recover full transaction amount, fees, interest, and costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 8 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed definitions, nonrecourse rule, ID/30-day hold rules, claimant affidavit demand, 7-day return/small claims petition, and third-party customer joinder.

headings.title: Crime of fraudulently pledging or selling misappropriated property
headings.reviewNote: Criminal offense when conveying customer fails to repay pawnbroker within ten business days of written certified mail demand.

headings.title: Penalties based on amount received
headings.reviewNote: Class B misdemeanor under $50; class A misdemeanor over $50 and under $150 (exact $50 unspecified in text); class D felony for $150 or more.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-17 note against archived text; confirmed 10-business-day repayment demand offense and tiered penalties (retaining statutory text where exact $50 threshold is unspecified).

headings.title: Purchaser court petition for return of purchase amount
headings.reviewNote: Court petition in county where pawnshop is located, small claims jurisdiction, and holding property pending resolution.

headings.title: Pre-judgment settlement and refund by pawnbroker
headings.reviewNote: Voluntary purchase price refund conditioned solely upon petition withdrawal; parties bear own costs.

headings.title: Third-party action against conveying customer and liability
headings.reviewNote: Third-party joinder of conveying customer; purchaser costs and attorney fees; customer liability for full amount, fees, and costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed purchaser petition/small claims jurisdiction, pre-judgment refund settlement, and conveying customer third-party liability.

headings.title: Release of hold order property for criminal investigation
headings.reviewNote: Written officer request for criminal evidence; officer receipt; 120-day investigation limit before return or warrant.

headings.title: Restriction on property release or disposition
headings.reviewNote: Pawnbroker prohibited from releasing property subject to hold order except upon court order or expiration.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed release of hold-order property to peace officer for 120-day criminal investigation without waiver and disposition restrictions.

headings.title: Prosecutor or circuit attorney evidence notice
headings.reviewNote: Written notice from prosecuting attorney or circuit attorney specifying case number, style, and property description when charges are filed.

headings.title: Property retention and fifteen-day disposition notice
headings.reviewNote: Pawnbroker holds property pending disposition; prosecutor must notify pawnbroker and claimant within fifteen days of case closing.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (1) title to include both prosecuting attorney and circuit attorney evidence notice and confirmed 15-day disposition notice.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for willful violations and false records
headings.reviewNote: Misdemeanor penalty up to $5,000 fine and six months jail; permanent license revocation upon second conviction; bona fide error defense.

headings.title: Penalties for unlicensed operation of pawnshop
headings.reviewNote: Misdemeanor up to $10,000 fine and one year jail for unlicensed operation; permanent bar on holding pawnshop license.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed misdemeanor penalties, permanent revocation on second conviction, bona fide error exception, and unlicensed operation penalties.

headings.title: Law enforcement inspection and hold order requirements
headings.reviewNote: Warrantless business-hours inspection; probable cause hold order containing six statutory items and officer/pawnbroker signatures.

headings.title: Secure retention, duration, and extensions of hold order
headings.reviewNote: Retention in secure area; initial duration up to two months; two 1-month extensions; written agency release.

headings.title: Expiration notice and title vesting in pawnbroker
headings.reviewNote: Written expiration notice to officer; title vests in pawnbroker after ten business days subject to claimant demands.

headings.title: License suspension or revocation for noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Gross negligence or willful violation is cause for license suspension/revocation; right of administrative and judicial appeal.

headings.title: Local regulation and pawnshop number limits
headings.reviewNote: Municipal ordinances consistent with state law; St. Louis City and populous charter counties authorized to cap number of pawnshops.

headings.title: Confidentiality and permissible uses of transaction records
headings.reviewNote: Pawn records confidential; restricted to investigating specific crimes, recordkeeping violations, and victim notifications.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections and history note against archived text; noted catchline ("search warrant required") vs body subsection (1) ("without prior notice or the necessity of obtaining a search warrant") discrepancy and confirmed hold-order, vesting, local-cap, and confidentiality rules.

headings.title: Consumer credit loan licensing fees and fund credit
headings.reviewNote: Tiered fee up to $5,000 plus branch fees; $1,000 low-volume cap; July 1 to June 30 period; consumer licensing fund credit.

headings.title: Issuance, contents, and posting of license certificate
headings.reviewNote: Director issues license upon fee payment; licensee must post certificate conspicuously at each business location.

headings.title: Nontransferability of license and duration
headings.reviewNote: License not assignable or transferable; address change permitted; remains in effect until surrendered, revoked, or suspended.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed tiered licensing fees, July 1–June 30 term, section 361.170 fund credit, posting, and nontransferability.

headings.title: Nondepository financial institution compliance mandate
headings.reviewNote: Mandatory compliance by nondepository lenders licensed under sections 367.100 to 367.215.

headings.title: Mandatory loan solicitation check warning
headings.reviewNote: Ten-point bold disclosure required on face of negotiable or facsimile checks warning of loan solicitation.

headings.title: Real estate loan default and cancellation warning
headings.reviewNote: Ten-point bold warning in contracts for loans secured by real estate regarding property loss risk and federal cancellation rights.

headings.title: Ability-to-repay underwriting requirement
headings.reviewNote: Lender duty to consider borrower's financial ability to reasonably repay loan in determining loan size and duration.

headings.title: Conspicuous posting of maximum loan rates and fees
headings.reviewNote: Mandatory conspicuous posting of current maximum rates and fees in each licensed office.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and mandatory bold-type notices against archived text; refined subsection (3) title to match "loans secured by real estate" and "right to cancel" statutory wording.

headings.title: Prohibition against loan broker advance fees
headings.reviewNote: Loan brokers strictly prohibited from charging, assessing, collecting, or receiving advance fees from borrowers.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for advance fee violations
headings.reviewNote: Knowing receipt or collection of advance fee by loan broker is a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed loan broker advance fee prohibition and class A misdemeanor for knowing violations.

headings.title: Merchandising practices act enforcement and rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Violations deemed unlawful merchandising practices under chapter 407; attorney general powers and rulemaking authority.

headings.title: Nonexclusive statutory and common law remedies
headings.reviewNote: Remedies nonexclusive; cumulative with other statutory, common law, and consumer protection rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed chapter 407 unlawful merchandising practice enforcement, attorney general rulemaking, and nonexclusive cumulative remedies.

headings.title: Regulatory authority and confidentiality of title lender data
headings.reviewNote: Director regulates title lenders; division staff must keep lender information confidential under sections 361.070 and 361.080.

headings.title: Conflict of interest prohibition for division employees
headings.reviewNote: Division employees prohibited from having financial interest in or receiving gratuities from title loan businesses.

headings.title: Issuance of licenses to qualified applicants
headings.reviewNote: Director duty to issue title loan licenses to all qualified applicants.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Rules effective only if promulgated pursuant to chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed division regulation, confidentiality under sections 361.070–361.080, employee conflict prohibition, license issuance, and chapter 536 rulemaking.

headings.title: Civil and criminal liability for unlicensed title lending
headings.reviewNote: Unlicensed title lending subject to both civil and criminal penalties.

headings.title: Invalidation of agreements and borrower liability limited to principal
headings.reviewNote: Unlicensed agreements and title pledges null and void; borrower liable only for return of original principal.

headings.title: Attorney general civil actions, daily penalties, and debarment
headings.reviewNote: Attorney general civil action; penalty $1,000 to $5,000 per day; five-year debarment for intentional violations.

headings.title: Criminal misdemeanor penalties and venue
headings.reviewNote: Class C misdemeanor for first offense; class A misdemeanor for subsequent offenses; venue in contracting or vehicle location county.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed voidness of unlicensed title loans/pledges, principal-only borrower liability, AG civil penalties/5-year bar, and misdemeanor penalties/venue.

headings.title: Minimum continuous capital requirement
headings.reviewNote: Title loan applicant and licensee must maintain capital of at least $75,000 at all times.

headings.title: Application requirements, surety bond, and letter of credit
headings.reviewNote: Sworn application, business locations, officer disclosures, $20,000 surety bond per location or irrevocable letter of credit.

headings.title: Licensing fees, account volume tiers, and licensing period
headings.reviewNote: Fees up to $5,000 plus branch fees, $1,000 low-volume cap, calendar year period, and credit to consumer licensing fund.

headings.title: License display and office relocation approval
headings.reviewNote: License must specify office location and be displayed; director approves relocation by issuing new license without charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed $75,000 capital requirement, sworn application, $20,000 bond or letter of credit per location, tiered calendar-year fees, and display/relocation.

headings.title: Mandatory written terms for title loan agreements
headings.reviewNote: Written agreement terms: pledge of unencumbered title, 30-day redemption, renewal principal reduction by 10% after 3rd renewal, default repossession.

headings.title: Personal liability for false pretenses and concealed liens
headings.reviewNote: Borrower personally liable for full loan amount if obtaining loan under false pretenses by concealing prior liens.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 7 mandatory written title loan terms (including 10% principal reduction from third renewal) and personal liability for concealed prior liens.

headings.title: Required disclosures and next-day cancellation right
headings.reviewNote: Seven required disclosures: Truth in Lending/Regulation Z, 10-point bold risk warning, interest rate, next-day cancellation right, delivery location.

headings.title: Model disclosure form drafted by division of finance
headings.reviewNote: Division model title loan form; use is optional but constitutes compliance with statutory disclosure requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (1) title to match statutory "cancel this loan" next-day notice and confirmed optional division model form.

headings.title: Consecutively numbered transaction recordkeeping
headings.reviewNote: Consecutively numbered records containing vehicle details, loan amount, date, maturity, and borrower personal and photo ID data.

headings.title: Borrower photo identification copying or photograph requirement
headings.reviewNote: Lender must photocopy borrower's photo identification or take instant photograph and attach to agreement and renewals.

headings.title: Agreement execution and title copy delivery
headings.reviewNote: Both parties must sign agreement; borrower receives copy of agreement and photocopy of pledged certificate of title.

headings.title: Two-year record retention and pre-closure examination notice
headings.reviewNote: Records retained at least two years from closing; ceasing business requires 2-year retention and 10 days advance notice to director.

headings.title: Warrantless inspection by division of finance
headings.reviewNote: Records available for inspection by division employees during ordinary business hours without warrant or court order.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed consecutively numbered records, photo ID copying/photographing, execution/title copy delivery, 2-year retention/10-day closure notice, and warrantless inspection.

headings.title: Mandatory pre-application borrower risk warning
headings.reviewNote: Ten-point bold disclosure and borrower signature acknowledging potential vehicle loss and short-term loan nature.

headings.title: Modification of warning for non-automobile personal property
headings.reviewNote: Procedure for modifying warning form when security is titled personal property other than an automobile.

headings.title: Conspicuous office posting of maximum rates and loss warning
headings.reviewNote: Fourteen-point bold office posting of maximum interest rates and vehicle risk notice.

headings.title: Ability-to-repay underwriting requirement
headings.reviewNote: Lender must consider borrower's financial ability to reasonably repay loan in determining loan size and duration.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections, embedded NOTICE TO BORROWER form table, and office posting notice against archived text; confirmed non-automobile modification rule and ability-to-repay requirement.

headings.title: Prohibited practices for title lenders
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits under-18/intoxicated loans, loans exceeding $5,000, waivers, property purchases, encumbered titles, and repossession storage over 15 miles away.

headings.title: Invalidation of noncompliant loans and liens
headings.reviewNote: Noncompliant transactions result in voiding both the loan and the underlying lien.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 9 prohibited title lender practices (including $5,000 cap and 15-mile storage limit) and voidness of noncompliant loans and liens.

headings.title: Safe storage of titles and pledged property
headings.reviewNote: Lender must maintain fireproof storage for pledged certificates of title and safe facilities for repossessed property.

headings.title: Mandatory premises liability insurance coverage
headings.reviewNote: Minimum one million dollars per occurrence premises liability insurance covering injuries from third-party criminal acts.

headings.title: Nonliability for property outside lender possession
headings.reviewNote: Title lender not liable for loss or injury caused by use of pledged property not in lender's actual possession.

headings.title: Strict liability for property in lender possession
headings.reviewNote: Title lender strictly liable to borrower for any loss to pledged property in the title lender's possession.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed fireproof title storage, $1M premises liability insurance, nonliability outside possession, and strict liability for any loss in possession.

headings.title: License suspension or revocation proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Suspension or revocation for statutory noncompliance or criminal acts after show-cause order and ten days notice for hearing.

headings.title: Cease and desist orders and daily civil penalties
headings.reviewNote: Director cease and desist orders for noncompliance with consumer loan laws; civil penalties up to $1,000 per day.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed license suspension/revocation show-cause hearing on 10 days notice and cease-and-desist orders with $1,000 daily civil penalties.
